task: Fix CLI Analytics dashboard latency and DB-pool contention under concurrent load by gating the ungated handlers onto one bounded connection (F1), serving repository/project rankings from a new pre-aggregated rollup (F2), and adding gate/pool instrumentation, light/heavy lane isolation and reserved ingest capacity (F3).

key_reasoning.reason: Three distinct subsystems change: the dashboard handler and its gate/budget (F1), a new repository/branch/project rollup stack with migration, builder job and reader rollup_* method on the port (F2), and pool/gate/ingest instrumentation plus a second lane and ingest reserve in the engine/settings/ingestor (F3). New abstractions (ranking rollup, light lane, metrics) and the shared analytics pool used by ingest and 4 background jobs. Base L, bumped for touching core shared infrastructure.

Ticket is detailed (findings, fix order, regression tests), but the F2 rollup design is open (new dimension, eligibility rules, branches-on-expand, rates-version staleness), F3 lane sizing and ingest reserve are unspecified, the 'agreed concurrent load' and Preview pool config are unknown, and the ticket wrongly assumes a 30 s cache on /repositories and /projects and omits get_sessions.

Closest pattern: get_tools bounded()/materialize_sel conversion (EPMCDME-17051) covers F1 exactly, and the user start-day rollups cover the build/staleness mechanics of F2, but no rollup keyed by repository/branch/project exists and parity with live ranking (order, cost, search, scope) must hold. F3 overturns the documented single-FIFO-gate decision and the exact-list gate-membership test; a misstep can starve ingest (503). Base L, bumped for performance as the primary concern. Note: the L calibration example (10401, provider + config UI) carries TR L with an established pattern; this task's F2/F3 lack one, so it sits above.

Modified: cli_analytics_handler.py, reader.py, project_page_sql.py, ports.py, engine.py, settings.py, ingestor.py, runtime.py, cli_analytics_jobs.py, config.py, prometheus_config.py, routers/cli_analytics.py, cli-analytics-storage guide, plus existing tests (dashboard gate, handler, bounded reader, reader, ports) — 16+. New: alembic_cli_analytics migration, ranking rollup builder, metrics module, live ranking-rollup parity test, ingest-under-load test, light-lane test — 6+. Spans service, repository/postgres, migrations, configs and tests.

API (router timing), Service (handler gate/lanes), DB-Persistence with a schema migration (new rollup tables), and Infrastructure (pool sizing, scheduler job, Prometheus metrics); instrumentation is a cross-cutting concern added across engine, handler and ingest.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from L to XL: performance/scalability is the primary concern
Component Scope bumped from L to XL: touches core shared infrastructure (the analytics asyncpg pool shared by dashboards, ingest and background jobs)

split_recommendation.ordering_note: All slices are in the codemie backend repo; land connection gating first because lane isolation and the rollup-served rankings both build on the gate membership and bounded-reader shape it establishes.

slices.title: Gate and bound the ungated CLI Analytics dashboard handlers
slices.scope: Move get_projects/_repository_rows, get_session_detail, get_activity and get_sessions onto dashboard_request() with one bounded connection (sel built once), update the gate-membership test, and add acquire-count regression tests.

slices.title: Instrument the analytics pool and isolate light/heavy lanes with ingest reserve
slices.scope: Add gate-wait, pool-wait and ingest-acquire metrics, then a light lane for rollup-served requests, a reserved ingest capacity and a bounded dashboard acquire timeout, with tests that light requests complete while heavy slots are held and ingest sees no 503s.
slices.depends_on: Gate and bound the ungated CLI Analytics dashboard handlers

slices.title: Serve repository and project rankings from a pre-aggregated rollup
slices.scope: Add a repository/branch/project rollup (migration, builder job with kill switch and rates-version staleness, reader rollup method with live fallback) and price only the page, with a live parity suite against the existing ranking.
slices.depends_on: Gate and bound the ungated CLI Analytics dashboard handlers
